subject: Concealing cables and equipment
hook: Media walls and TV units with every cable and box kept out of sight.
gbp:
A wall-mounted TV looks great until you see the cables trailing down to a soundbar, a router and a set-top box on the floor. A SUPERIO media wall or TV unit is designed so all of that disappears.

We plan the cable route before anything is built: a void behind the back panel, cable holes placed where each device sits, and a removable access panel so you can add or swap equipment later. Closed cupboards are planned with ventilation in mind, and kit that needs a remote signal gets an open shelf or a slatted front. We will also tell you where your electrician should place sockets before fitting day.

Media walls and TV units are made to measure in our own workshop in Hanley, in finishes such as charcoal, oak-effect, matt black and slatted panels, then delivered and installed by our own team. We work with homeowners in Stone and across Staffordshire.

It starts with a free, no-obligation design consultation and an itemised quote. Tap the button below to see our media walls.
